definitions.explanation: Changes in quantity, going up or down; variation in numbers or amounts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増減|ぞうげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To investigate the increase and decrease in population.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増減|ぞうげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: The fluctuation in sales is significant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増減|ぞうげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}する→影響：01877_eikyou⟧。

notes:
{増減|ぞうげん} describes both increases and decreases—the overall variation or fluctuation in quantity.
